newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $530 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $530 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday were expected to total $530 million in 20 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $496 million in 12 sales, with a $200 million Milwaukee Metropolitain Sewer, Wis., offering through Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc, topping the list.
On the competitive side, eight sales totaling $34 million are scheduled. A eight million Chesire, Conn., offering at 1130 EDT is the largest.
One additional sale totaling $1.5 million is on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issue Thursday depending on market conditions.
